8. Have prior experience and knowledge of Credit cards. 9. Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams on fraud-related projects.
10. Provide training and support to junior analysts on fraud detection techniques.

1. 1-5 years of experience in data analysis and fraud detection.
2. Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools.
3. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
4. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
5. Experience in a financial services environment.
6. Familiarity with machine learning techniques for fraud detection.
